data.desc: Costco Wholesale currently operates 947 warehouses worldwide and 117 warehouses across Canada. This Lloydminster location is the second of 4 new warehouse openings this week across Canada. NE Edmonton, Alberta - November 18th, Lloydminster, Alberta - November 19th, East Windsor, Ontario - November 20th, Wasaga Beach, Ontario - November 21st. The first Costco Wholesale location in Canada opened in Burnaby, BC in October 1985. Costco Wholesale employs over 50,000 people in Canada. Its Canadian head office is located at 415 West Hunt Club Road in Ottawa. Revenues from corporate sales for the fiscal year ending August 30, 2026, were of $297.3 billion (US) (COST - NASDAQ).
